# Minimal bead-type list for the t_library unit tests.
# Deliberately tiny and stable: the tests assert exact counts and values, so
# do not add entries here without updating tests/t_library.c.
# DPD bead types.
# Sources: Anderson et al, JCP 147, 094503 (2017); Anderson et al,
#          JChem Theory Comput 14, 2633 (2018); Wand et al, Langmuir 36,
#          12288 (2020). The per-row source column is not yet attributed;
#          '-' means it still has to be filled in from those three.

bead_types

#                         (dpd)    (e)     (kT)     (rc)
